api.about.title: About API Services
api.about.text1: API services are used to automatically fetch component data such as name, description, datasheet, and image when adding new components.
api.about.text2: To use this feature, you need to:
api.about.step1: Create an account on the supplier’s website
api.about.step3: Add the service and API key here
api.about.note: This feature is optional and intended to speed up initial component entry, especially when adding many items.
